sources.locator: XT660R [XT660X] section
sources.claim: R is the trail model; X is the supermoto variation. Both are 660 cc fuel-injected singles. XT600E is their predecessor, not this firmware family.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R(S)/XT660X(S) 2004 service manual
sources.locator: Wiring diagram; PDF pages 345 and 462
sources.claim: Early R/X wiring reference used in the existing connector study. No O2 sensor is shown in this diagram. This does not establish every later market specification.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R 5VK1 parts catalogue
sources.locator: Electrical 1, PDF page 43
sources.claim: Lists 5VK-8591A-00 and 5VK-8591A-01 ECU references. Model-year association comes from the host catalogue index/filename; the 2008 copyright is a catalogue reprint date.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R(W)/XT660X(W) 2007 supplementary service manual
sources.locator: PDF pages 55, 56 and 79–81; wiring legend item 68
sources.claim: The 2007 R/X supplement adds an O2 sensor and its feedback/fault handling. Use with the 2004 base manual; do not reuse the early connector as a verified 2007 pinout.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R 3S63 parts catalogue
sources.locator: Electrical 1, PDF page 43
sources.claim: Lists 5VK-8591A-10 and harness 5VK-H2590-20. This is a specific model-code record, not every R/X market.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R 2C13 Brazil parts catalogue, January 2008
sources.locator: Cover; Electrical 1, figure 43 item 13
sources.claim: Brazil 2C13 catalogue identifies ECU 2C1-8591A-00. Matching a local filename to this part number is not a dump-year or hardware identity check. Harness reference is 5VK-H2590-10, distinct from the later -20 reference.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R 2C19 Brazil parts catalogue, July 2013 edition
sources.locator: Cover/chassis 9C6KM0030E…; figure 43 item 13, printed page 58; figure 11 item 7, printed page 13
sources.claim: 2014 2C19 catalogue lists ECU 2C1-8591A-10 and harness 5VK-H2590-20. It corroborates 2014, not the entire 2012–2016 filename range. Exhaust figure 11 lists oxygen sensor 1B9-8592A-00.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R 5VKL catalogue 1N5VK-300S1, June 2013 edition
sources.locator: Cover; PDF page 19 exhaust; page 65 electrical 1
sources.claim: 5VKL for Europe, Chile/Venezuela, Israel/South Africa and Mexico uses 5VK-8591A-11; exhaust lists 1B9-8592A-00 oxygen sensor. Publication date alone is not the supplied dump model year.

sources.title: Yamaha product library: XT660Z-Tenere, Europe, 2008
sources.locator: Model name / area / model year
sources.claim: The Ténéré is XT660Z. No XT660T firmware is identified in this dataset.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660Z 2008 parts catalogue 1G11D300E1
sources.locator: Electrical 1, PDF page 43 item 27; exhaust figure 12 item 2
sources.claim: Lists ECU 11D-8591A-00, harness 11D-H2590-00 and oxygen sensor 1B9-8592A-00. No matching local firmware was identified.

sources.title: Yamaha TDM900 2002 service manual
sources.locator: Model identification/specifications and fuel-injection wiring
sources.claim: TDM900 is a separate twin-cylinder comparison platform. Similar fallback values and dormant second-channel code do not identify an XT dump as TDM firmware.

sources.title: Yamaha TDM900 5PS1 Europe / TDM900P 5PS2 Oceania parts catalogue
sources.locator: Cover/model identification
sources.claim: Documents distinct 5PS model codes. No TDM-labelled or proven TDM firmware exists in the supplied folder.

sources.title: Yamaha XT660R 3S61 parts catalogue
sources.locator: Electrical 1, PDF page 43 items 13 and 20
sources.claim: The 2005-indexed 3S61 record lists 5VK-8591A-00 and harness 5VK-H2590-00. It does not match the local companion filename 5VK-8591A-01 exactly.
